name: AU-rich element mRNA destabilization by TTP, BRF1 and KSRP
rationale: All three members are ARE-binding proteins (TTP, BRF1/ZFP36L1, KSRP) that bind and destabilize mRNA; confusables cover the downstream decapping/deadenylation machinery, AUF1/HuR, or stress granules instead.

name: SHC1 and GRB2 adaptor events in ERBB signaling
rationale: Every member is a SHC1 or GRB2 docking event downstream of EGFR, ERBB2 or ERBB4, whereas confusables add PI3K, PLCG1, GRB7 or GAB1 branches and receptor-pair pathways.

name: Extracellular restraint of Nodal signaling by ligand sequestration
rationale: Members describe extracellular ligand/BMP sequestration and negative regulation of Nodal, including its role in lateral mesoderm left/right asymmetry; C1 covers intracellular BMP/TGF-beta/SMAD regulation and C4 organ laterality.

name: PTEN-AKT signaling control and inositol polyphosphate synthesis
rationale: Most members concern PTEN regulation, AKT targets and negative PI3K/AKT/IGF1R signaling, alongside nuclear/cytosolic inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis (plus PAK-2p34 cell-death regulation); confusables add serine autophosphorylation or pyrophosphate hydrolysis.

name: UDP-GlcNAc and UDP-glucose supply for N-linked glycosylation
rationale: Members cover synthesis of UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucose and dolichyl-phosphate-glucose and their GFPT1/ALG14 myasthenic-syndrome defects; confusables instead cover N-glycan processing, GPI anchors or sialic acid metabolism.

core: Oxylipin and pro-resolving lipid mediator metabolism
name: Lipoxygenase and P450 oxylipins, including pro-resolving mediators
rationale: Members span leukotrienes, lipoxins, HETEs, EETs, hepoxilins, resolvins, protectins and maresins plus fatty acid omega-oxidation; confusables add the cyclooxygenase prostanoid branch and prostanoid receptors.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell homeostasis and bone marrow hemopoiesis
rationale: Members regulate HSC homeostasis, division, proliferation and differentiation and bone marrow development; confusables focus on lineage-specific myeloid, B or T cell differentiation or pluripotency.

name: Autophagosome assembly and maturation by lysosome fusion
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome assembly and maturation and fusion of autophagosomes, MVBs and late endosomes with lysosomes; confusables add phagosome/endosomal fusion, xenophagy or selective autophagy.

name: Mitochondrial RNA processing, tRNA maturation and mitoribosome assembly
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial mRNA/tRNA/rRNA processing, modification and stability, general tRNA end processing and splicing, and mitoribosome subunit assembly; confusables add mitochondrial transcription, translation and DNA replication.

core: Fasting hormonal control of hepatic fuel metabolism
name: Glucagon-PKA fasting control of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride metabolism
rationale: Members cover glucagon response and secretion, PKA/AMPK/PDE3B signaling and regulation of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride turnover; confusables emphasize ChREBP glucose sensing, LXR lipogenesis, insulin/adiponectin or glycogen.

name: BDNF-TRKB-driven actin remodeling of dendrites and spines
rationale: Members cover dendrite arborization, spine/filopodium regulation and postsynaptic actin organization driven by BDNF/NTRK2 and EPHB signaling; confusables add NMDAR-RAC1, PSD maintenance and synaptic plasticity.

name: Nuclear export of mature mRNA and ribosomal subunits
rationale: Members center on export of mature mRNAs, ribosomal subunits and tRNA from the nucleus and its regulation; confusables cover nuclear pore assembly and protein import/export or RNA processing and decay.

name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor binding and resistance of PDGFR mutants
rationale: All members describe TKI binding to or resistance of PDGFR mutants; confusables are the equivalent KIT and FLT3 mutant sets.

qualifier: acidification and lysosomal fusion at host-pathogen interface
name: Phagosome acidification and lysosome fusion in microbial killing
rationale: Members cover phagosome acidification, phagolysosome fusion, ion flux and iron competition at the host-pathogen interface and PMN phagocytolysis; confusables add Mtb immune evasion or peptide transporters.

qualifier: palate, face, thymus, thyroid, parathyroid and spleen
name: Craniofacial, palate and thymus-thyroid-parathyroid-spleen organogenesis
rationale: Members are face, viscerocranium, palate and outer-ear morphogenesis plus thymus, thyroid, parathyroid and spleen development; confusables add outflow tract/trachea, limbs, or exocrine glands and inner/middle ear.

qualifier: and resistance of ERBB2 cancer mutants
name: ERBB2-targeted drug inhibition and mutant resistance
rationale: Members cover drug inhibition of ERBB2 and resistance of ERBB2 kinase and TMD/JMD mutants to specific inhibitors; confusables cover oncogenic signaling by RTK mutants or TKI resistance in KIT, PDGFR and ALK.

name: Nicotinic cholinergic transmission and clostridial neurotoxin blockade
rationale: Most members concern acetylcholine synthesis, choline transport, release, nicotinic receptors and botulinum/tetanus toxin blockade of release; confusables cover NMJ assembly, muscarinic/serotonin GPCRs, or GABA/glutamate transport.

core: RNA polymerase I/III transcription elongation and termination
name: RNA polymerase I/III elongation, termination and early rRNA processing
rationale: Members are Pol I and Pol III elongation/termination (plus Pol II elongation) and 5'-ETS rRNA processing; confusables add promoter initiation, rDNA chromatin regulation and later ITS cleavages.

name: Fatty acid and neurotransmitter regulation of islet hormone secretion
rationale: Members describe insulin and glucagon secretion control by fatty acids (FFAR1, HCA receptors), GLP-1, acetylcholine and adrenaline; confusables add incretin synthesis, glucagon-family receptors, somatostatin and cAMP signaling.

core: Intracellular cobalamin metabolism and inherited defects
name: Intracellular cobalamin metabolism and its inherited methylmalonic disorders
rationale: Members cover cellular cobalamin processing (CD320, MMACHC, MMADHC, MMAA, MMAB, MUT, MTR) and propionyl-CoA catabolism; confusables cover dietary uptake and plasma transport of cobalamin, or other organic acidemias.

name: Regulation of JNK and p38 stress-activated kinase cascades
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate JNK and p38 cascades, including TAK1- and ALPK1-mediated activation; confusables add AP-1 transcription, ERK feedback, TLR-TAK1 activation or NOD signaling.

name: Phase I oxidation of amines and plant-derived compounds
rationale: Members are FMO and CYP1A2 oxidation, oxidative demethylation and metabolism of alkaloids, terpenoids and phenylpropanoids; confusables add conjugation reactions and general xenobiotic catabolism.

name: Regulation of synaptic neurotransmitter release and reuptake
rationale: All three members regulate how much neurotransmitter is released or cleared at synapses; confusables are specific catecholamine transporters or synaptic vesicle cycle machinery.

core: Phosphatidylserine exposure and apoptotic cell clearance
qualifier: membrane lipid asymmetry and mechanical membrane responses
name: Phospholipid asymmetry, PS exposure and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members cover flippase/scramblase control of membrane lipid asymmetry, PS exposure, recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells, plus blebbing, volume and pressure responses; confusables cover intermembrane lipid transfer, ER shaping, apical trafficking or surfactant.

qualifier: post-ER: COPI, endosome-Golgi and lysosomal routes
name: Golgi organization and post-ER Golgi-endosome-lysosome vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover Golgi assembly, COPI retrograde and intra-Golgi transport, endosome-Golgi exchange, lysosome targeting, recycling and ARF/RAB GAP regulation; confusables cover ER translocation and COPII export or RAB prenylation and GEFs.
